lanes.linear_title: Clear the cached workspace navigation model on account or scope change
lanes.linear_description:
## Context (verified 2026-10-04)
Draft PR #583 (branch claude/access-scope-enrollment-e2e, stacked on the #564 release base) added browser case 4 in e2e/access-scope.spec.ts: sign out in-tab, then sign in as a different user (outsider.demo, org 2). In 4 of 6 runs with 2 workers, and in both full-lane runs, the outsider briefly saw client.demo's parts list on /parts. Root cause found by the implementer: `useWorkspaceNavigationModel` (src/features/quotes/use-workspace-navigation-model.ts, `stableModelRef` ~line 203, plus `lastRejectedStateRef` / `lastCommittedSignatureRef`) keeps the last coherent model in React refs that are not keyed by the signed-in user or access scope. ClientParts renders `navigationModel.parts` and `sidebarProjects` from that ref, so the `queryClient.removeQueries` purge in src/hooks/use-app-session.ts cannot clear it. Case 4 is currently gated behind `E2E_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_LEAK_CHECK=1` (e2e/access-scope.spec.ts ~line 352).
This violates release-proof R9 ("logout, account/org switch and role changes synchronously remove prior-scope rendered/cache data before exposing the next session") and is a cross-account exposure class defect.

## Scope
- Key every cached/stabilized navigation state in useWorkspaceNavigationModel (and any sibling hook found to keep a similar unkeyed ref feeding customer-visible lists) by the authenticated user id plus the active organization/access scope. When the key changes (including to signed-out), synchronously reset to the empty model before rendering any data, so no frame shows the previous scope's rows.
- Remove the `E2E_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_LEAK_CHECK` gate so case 4 always runs.
- Add a focused unit test (vitest + React Testing Library) that renders the hook/component with user A data, switches the session to user B with B's queries pending, and asserts zero A rows are rendered at any point (check every render, not only the final one).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Failure-first: on the base (claude/access-scope-enrollment-e2e @ ba7a3fd) the new unit test fails and case 4 fails at least once in `--repeat-each=10 --workers=2`; record both outputs.
- [ ] With the fix: the unit test passes; case 4 passes 20/20 with `--repeat-each=20 --workers=2` (authenticated lane, as user ubuntu, DB lock held across reset+seed+setup-auth+spec); the full access-scope spec and the existing smoke tests still pass.
- [ ] No new customer-facing copy; no change to auth/session semantics other than resetting the cached model on key change.
- [ ] Lint, typecheck and affected vitest suites pass.

## Verification
- `npx vitest run src/features/quotes` (and the new test)
- authenticated lane: reset + seed + e2e/fixtures/beta-access.sql + setup-auth, then `npx playwright test --grep-invert @fixture e2e/access-scope.spec.ts --repeat-each=20 --workers=2` as user ubuntu under /tmp/ovd-e2e.lock and /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock (see ENV.md; if `flock ... sh -c`/runuser are refused by the session guard, use a scratchpad wrapper script as earlier units did).

## Out of scope
Any visual change; the separate deferred UI work; seed changes beyond what #583 already has.
Parent context: release-proof R9 (Linear issue pending: workspace issue limit).
lanes.guidance: Start by reading use-workspace-navigation-model.ts fully and ClientParts/ClientWorkspace consumers. Derive a scopeKey from the session (user id + active organization id + access scope / beta access state if it gates lists). Store the key alongside stableModelRef; when it differs from the current key during render, reset all three refs to their initial values and return EMPTY_MODEL for that render. Prefer render-time comparison over useEffect so the very first render after a switch is clean. Check use-app-session.ts for the exact session fields; do not change the purge logic itself.
lanes.failure_first: Write the unit test first and run it against the unmodified hook (must fail by rendering an A row after the switch). Run case 4 ungated on the base 10x2 and capture at least one failure.

lanes.linear_title: Browser-test STEP intake, reload restore, duplicate and empty selections
lanes.linear_description:
## Context
- #564 adds two intake guards (OVD-527), both covered by unit tests only:
  - a client-side empty-file check in src/features/quotes/file-validation.ts:32-35;
  - a concurrent duplicate-selection guard in src/features/quotes/use-client-job-file-picker.ts.
- No browser test covers STEP intake end to end (U3, U4).
- The enrolled-client seed this test needs comes from the ACCESS-SCOPE-ENROLLMENT-E2E branch.
- No worker runs in the authenticated lane, so CAD extraction never completes there.

## Scope
Add `e2e/intake.spec.ts` (authenticated lane, client.demo enrolled) and two fixtures: `e2e/fixtures/intake/empty.step` (0 bytes) and `e2e/fixtures/intake/garbage.step` (plain non-STEP text). Cases:
1. Upload test-fixtures/quoted-sample/1093-05589-02.STEP through the intake input. The page lands on /parts/<uuid>, and after a reload it shows the same part.
2. Hold the first intake RPC (api_create_client_draft, or whichever runs first) with page.route. Meanwhile run a second setInputFiles with the same file. After release, the client's org job count has risen by exactly 1 (counted through REST as client.demo).
3. empty.step shows the existing empty-file toast. No intake RPC is called and no job is created.
4. garbage.step brings the browser CAD viewer to a finite error state within 30 s. Header-based rejection is not asserted (Q24).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The spec passes in the locked authenticated run, together with the access-scope and smoke specs.
- [ ] Failure first: in a scratch worktree of this branch with file-validation.ts and use-client-job-file-picker.ts restored to 8d8d243, cases 2 and 3 fail. The output is recorded.
- [ ] `npx vitest run src/features/quotes/use-client-job-file-picker.test.tsx` passes.
- [ ] The CI authenticated step is green.

## Verification commands
```bash
flock /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock flock /tmp/ovd-e2e.lock sh -c 'supabase db reset --local && npm run seed:dev && chmod -R a+rwX . && sudo -u ubuntu -H env PATH=$PATH PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers npx playwright test --grep-invert @fixture'
npx vitest run src/features/quotes/use-client-job-file-picker.test.tsx
npm run lint && npm run typecheck
flock /tmp/ovd-verify.lock npm run verify
```

## Out of scope
- Re-selection after an intake completes (Q22).
- STEP header validation (Q24).
- Server idempotency (Q23).
- Worker extraction.
- Product code.

Parent: OVD-527
lanes.guidance:
COMMON RULES (all units):
(1) Create the worktree under /home/user/wt/intake: `git -C /home/user/Overdrafter fetch origin && git -C /home/user/Overdrafter worktree add /home/user/wt/intake -b <branch> origin/claude/access-scope-enrollment-e2e`. If that base is missing on origin, stop with status 'blocked'. Never edit /home/user/Overdrafter.
(2) Run `npm ci`.
(3) Locks: take /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock first, then /tmp/ovd-e2e.lock, then /tmp/ovd-verify.lock. Before Playwright, run `flock /tmp/ovd-replay.lock true`. Before each locked run, confirm that 127.0.0.1:4173 is free.
(4) Run Playwright as ubuntu with the sandbox on: `chmod -R a+rwX` the worktree, then `sudo -u ubuntu -H env PATH=$PATH PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers ...`.
(5) Commit trailers per ENV.md. No force-push.
(6) The PR title starts with this unit's issue ID. Never write the parent ID anywhere.
(7) No product code or copy changes.
(8) Do not edit .sonarcloud.properties.
(9) Cite gap IDs. Never claim U3/U4 complete (Q13).

STEPS
1. Find the 1.0 intake control and its hidden file input on the client routes (/parts or ClientHome). Use setInputFiles on that input.
2. Use git to add the 0-byte file. Check it in with `git ls-files -s`, because some tooling strips empty files.
3. Case 2:
   - Route the first intake RPC with a promise gate, then call setInputFiles a second time while it is held.
   - Count jobs before and after with `GET /rest/v1/jobs?select=id&organization_id=eq.<org A id>`, using client.demo's access token from the page's Supabase session.
4. Case 4: wait for the viewer's existing error UI and assert it by role or text. If none exists within 30 s, record the actual state and report; do not add UI.
5. Failure first:
   - Create a scratch worktree at this branch.
   - Run `git checkout 8d8d243 -- src/features/quotes/file-validation.ts src/features/quotes/use-client-job-file-picker.ts`.
   - If that fails to compile, revert only the #564 guard hunks instead, by hand.
   - Run the spec under both locks and record that cases 2 and 3 fail.
   - Remove the scratch worktree.
6. Open the draft PR against claude/access-scope-enrollment-e2e (a stacked PR).

Schedule: lane C, order 3. Depends on ACCESS-SCOPE-ENROLLMENT-E2E. Cut priority: third to drop if wall-clock runs short.
lanes.failure_first:
In a scratch worktree of this branch, restore the two #564 guard files (file-validation.ts and use-client-job-file-picker.ts) to their 8d8d243 versions, or revert just the guard hunks. Run the spec under both locks.

Case 3 must fail (the empty file proceeds to intake), and case 2 must fail (2 jobs are created). Record the output, then run the real branch green.
